summary: Richmond Mutual Bancorporation (RMBI) filed an 8-K attaching a communication from The Farmers Bancorp regarding their pending merger. RMBI is the target in this stock-for-stock acquisition. The filing does not disclose per-share price, premium, or implied value. The board has recommended the deal; no advisors are named. The merger is subject to regulatory approvals and customary closing conditions, with a risk of termination if approvals are delayed. The risk-arb spread depends on regulatory timeline and shareholder votes. Key watchpoints include integration risks, cost-synergy realization, and any competing bids.
